meta.name: cfo-advisor
meta.description: Financial leadership for startups and scaling companies. Financial modeling, unit economics, fundraising strategy, cash management, and board financial packages. Use when building financial models, analyzing unit economics, planning fundraising, managing cash runway, preparing board materials, or when user mentions CFO, burn rate, runway, fundraising, unit economics, LTV, CAC, term sheets, or financial strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为初创公司提供财务建模与融资策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是初创公司创始人或CFO，需要财务模型和融资支持。
copy.tagline_en: Provide financial modeling and fundraising strategy for startups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a startup founder or CFO needing financial models and fundraising support.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演创业公司CFO顾问，帮你做财务模型、分析单位经济、规划融资、管理现金流、准备董事会材料，并主动预警烧钱率过高、跑道不足等风险。
howto.when: 当你提到CFO、烧钱率、跑道、融资、单位经济、LTV、CAC、条款清单等关键词，或要求做财务模型、分析单位经济、规划融资时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下我们公司的单位经济，按渠道分CAC和LTV。
我们当前烧钱率是多少？按乐观、基准、悲观三种场景模拟跑道。
say.note: Claude会运行烧钱率计算器，给出不同场景下的跑道长度。

say.text: 准备融资材料，包括指标仪表盘、财务模型和估值分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a CFO advisor for startups, helping with financial modeling, unit economics analysis, fundraising strategy, cash management, and board materials. It proactively alerts on high burn rate, short runway, and other red flags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention CFO, burn rate, runway, fundraising, unit economics, LTV, CAC, term sheets, or ask for financial models, unit economics analysis, or fundraising planning.

say_en.text: Analyze our unit economics by channel, showing CAC and LTV per cohort.
What's our current burn rate? Simulate runway under base, bull, and bear scenarios.
say_en.note: Claude runs the burn rate calculator and shows runway for each scenario.

say_en.text: Prepare fundraising materials including metrics dashboard, financial model, and valuation analysis.
